name: skodd
description: Skodd - dekk som abonnement. Monorepo: domenekjerne, API og mobilapp.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @skodd/core && npm run build -w @skodd/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @skodd/core && npm run test -w @skodd/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @skodd/core && npm run typecheck -w @skodd/api
scripts.preview: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE=/ npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist && cd ../.. && node infra/forhandsvisning.mjs apps/mobile/dist
scripts.demo: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1 npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-demo --clear && cd ../.. && node infra/lag-demoside.mjs apps/mobile/dist-demo skodd-appen.html
